title: Engineer turns Claude Code into a UK tax-law research agent over ~10,000 documents
summary: Martin Alderson had Claude Code scrape UK legislation and HMRC tax manuals into folders, then repurposed CLAUDE.md with research instructions so the agent could search the corpus to answer tax-policy questions.
agent_role: Claude Code wrote the recursive scraper, built the document corpus and searched it to answer questions; Alderson designed the setup and judged the answers.

curation.rationale: Launch seed collection, researched from search results.
